Hi Maria —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery:

Summary of compliance scope we discussed:
- Primary need: confirm Redwood's SOC 2 Type II coverage for inference platform and data processing (relevant for Acme's PII flows).
- Secondary: GDPR data processing details and HIPAA scoping for a subset of the workload (PHI in debug logs).
- Acme will share a vendor security questionnaire (VSQ); Redwood will start intake and provide evidence.

What we need from your side
- Please share the VSQ (or a link to OneTrust) — if you'd prefer, we can open the questionnaire on our side and provide answers.
- Any specific scoping notes (which envs/data classes to include) so we can surface the right evidence.

What we'll deliver
- Redwood will provide our latest SOC 2 Type II report (or a bridge letter if the Type II is under processing), plus a short evidence packet mapping.
- We'll invite Acme to our Trust Portal for read-only evidence access and add your security reviewers.

Attachments in this email: VSQ-Initiation-Checklist.xlsx (short checklist to speed intake).

Target timeline
- If possible, we'd aim to get your VSQ by EOD Friday (2026-02-19) so we can prioritize the PoC review with your security team the week after. If that timeline is aggressive, tell us what works and we'll adapt.

Next steps
1) Maria: share the VSQ or OneTrust link.
2) We: Rishi + Marissa will collate SOC2/bridge materials and invite Acme to the Trust Portal.
3) Quick sync if any scoping questions (15 min).

Thanks — happy to coordinate timing.

Best,
Jonas
